title: Experts pulled outside their field; Joe Frazier in South Carolina
summary: Johnston describes refusing to speak outside her expertise and recalls a boxer addressing the South Carolina legislature.

blocks.x: Well I'm glad you did. And I'm certainly in a good position to know a good deal about that because it happens to people who get PhDs. You get a PhD in English and the next thing you know they are asking you to talk about everything in the world. Subjects as you say, you are totally incapable of speaking on with any expertise.

And it's one thing that I have done with my career, I have refused to be siphoned off into political areas and other areas in which I do not have any measure of expertise at all. Some intelligent thought, but that's not the same thing as expertise. But a lot of people cannot resist the pulls.
